Ministry of Finance: This entity is the government body responsible for the issuance of the regulatory notification.

Customs Act 2023: Section 25(1) of this Act empowers the Government to issue notifications regarding customs regulations.
Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty A: Section 126(1) of this Act provides the legal authority for the Government to implement fiscal measures in consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
National Board of Revenue: The Government is required to consult with this body when exercising its legal powers to issue or amend regulatory notifications.
S.R.O. 178-AIN/2024: This existing notification is being formally amended by the current regulatory order.
